reason: The statement declares s:U(1) x calX -> calX and then asserts that s is a continuous bilinear map. This is not well-typed: U(1) is not a real or complex vector space (it is not closed under addition or scalar multiplication), so bilinearity cannot be asserted for a map on U(1) x calX. The valid smoothness argument requires introducing the ambient bilinear scalar-multiplication map s_tilde:C x calX -> calX and then restricting s_tilde to the embedded submanifold U(1) x calM_delta. Node 1.3 does not state that correctly and therefore contains a false/type-invalid assertion even though the intended repair is local.
